title: Elon Musk Touts a ‘Storm’ of Tesla Cybercabs in Austin, Says They Offer Better ‘Operational Efficiency’ Than Waymo
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在奥斯汀吹捧特斯拉 Cyber​​cab 的“风暴”，称它们提供比 Waymo 更好的“运营效率”
summary: Tesla Inc. CEO Elon Musk has backed the Cybercab ahead of its launch event in Austin, Texas, as the EV maker looks to expand its Robotaxi network. A Storm Of Cybercabs In a post on X in the early hours...
summary_zh: 特斯拉公司首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在 Cyber​​cab 在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的发布会之前表示支持，该电动汽车制造商希望扩大其 Robotaxi 网络。一场网络出租车风暴 在凌晨 X 上的一篇帖子中……

title: Waymo raises $3 billion in first-ever debt deal with Pimco, Blackstone
title_zh: Waymo 通过与 Pimco 和 Blackstone 的首笔债务交易筹集了 30 亿美元
summary: The Alphabet unit is working with Goldman Sachs to finalize the loan, which could price at more than 500 basis points over the benchmark
summary_zh: Alphabet 部门正在与高盛合作敲定这笔贷款，贷款定价可能比基准高出 500 个基点以上

title: Waymo taps into debt markets with $3B deal with Pimco, Blackstone - report
title_zh: Waymo 与 Pimco、Blackstone 达成 30 亿美元交易，进军债务市场 - 报告
summary: Investing.com -- Waymo is close to securing its first debt financing, with Pacific Investment Management Co. and other lenders set to provide more than $3 billion to Alphabet Inc.'s autonomous driving unit, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据彭博社周三报道，Waymo 即将获得首笔债务融资，太平洋投资管理公司和其他贷方将向 Alphabet Inc. 的自动驾驶部门提供超过 30 亿美元。
